items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And Mezzrow brought him in and introduced him to me and I told him, and I said where do you live, and he told me on the South Side.

ctx.x: At Jeffrey Tavern. Really on the deep South Side, you know? And it was -- and Genie lived in the same neighborhood. So one night Mezzrow brought Gene Krupa into the old Savoy in Chicago, and I could remember that face. I said, now this kid I really know, I can't remember where I saw him at. And Mezzrow brought him in and introduced him to me and I told him, and I said where do you live, and he told me on the South Side. I said, how about Jeffrey Tavern, because I used to see him over the fence, you know,…
I mean, before he got drums, even.
